policy_metadata.policy_title: Tools and Resources for Physicians and Other Healthcare Providers Consolidated G

sections.heading: Table of contents
content: Provider Payment Integrity Policies Key Contacts This document provides an inventory of commonly used self-service tools and resources Humana created to make it easier for you to find the information you need. You can also easily navigate to this information on Humana’s newly redesigned website Provider.Humana.com. Note: When downloaded, this document becomes uncontrolled. Do not rely on printed copies for the most up-to-date version; instead, please use the links included.

rows.• Consult clinical practice guidelines f:
• Cohere Health
– Request preauthorization for pain management, musculoskeletal
procedures, therapy, cardiac imaging, devices and interventions,
endoscopies and diagnostic imaging.
• Chemotherapy services (Group Medicare and Medicare Advantage – HMO-
POS and PPO Only and KY Medicaid)
­ OncoHealth reviews preauthorization requests [for practices in CT, DE, MA, MD,
ME, NH, NJ, NY, PA and VT].
­ Evolent reviews preauthorization requests for all other states and Dual
(Medicare-Medicaid) plans in IL, SC, MI and FL.
­ Humana’s medical intake team (MIT) also known as Humana’s Clinical Pharmacy
Review (HCPR) reviews preauthorization requests for private fee-for-service
(PFFS).
• Fax: 888-447-3430. Request forms are available.
• Phone: 866-461-7273 Monday – Friday, 8 a.m. – 11 p.m., Eastern time
• Oncology therapy services (radiation and surgical services for Group
Medicare and Medicare Advantage – HMO-POS and PPO Only)
­ Evolent reviews preauthorization requests for all states and Dual (Medicare-
Medicaid) plans in IL, SC, MI and FL.
­ Humana’s clinical intake team (CIT) reviews preauthorization requests for private
fee-for-service (PFFS).
• Fax: 800-266-3022
• Phone: 800-523-0023 Monday – Friday, 7 a.m. – 7 p.m., Eastern time
• PR phone: 866-488-5995 Monday – Friday, 8:30 a.m. – 5:30 p.m., local time
• Tivity Health, Inc.: Obtain information about fitness and health products
primarily for seniors and older adults
• WholeHealth Living, Inc.: Administers leased network management,
utilization management (UM) and claim payments for chiropractic,
acupuncture, naturopathy and therapeutic massage services. Services vary
by line of business and state.
­ Chiropractic network: Available in AZ, GA, IL, KY, OH and IN counties bordering
IL, KY and OH.
­ Acupuncture: Available in AZ, AK, CO, CT, DC, DE, FL, HI, ID, KY, ME, MD, MA,
MO, NH, NC, NJ, NM, NY, OH, OR, PA, TX, UT, VT, VA, WA and WY.
